title: Concept: Dependency fetched through scp-style git
description: package.json declares a `git@host:` specifier that relies on SSH trust, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `git@host:` specifier that relies on SSH trust.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `git@host:` specifier that relies on SSH trust.
